description: Validates end-to-end integration testing has been completed

checks.description: The integration test report must exist
checks.remediation: Run integration-testing/scripts/run_suite.py with --report-dir set to the project's artifacts/Testing

checks.description: Every suite check must have passed
checks.remediation: Fix each failed check listed in the report, then re-run the suite

checks.description: The report should include the project's gate results
checks.remediation: Run the suite with --project so the report covers this project's gates
